Priya: hey team — planning a canary tonight 22:00 PT. Starting at 1% global for 15m, then 5% for 30m if smoke is green. Need deploy owner + rollback owner + smoke lead.

Leo: I'll be deploy owner. I'll watch infra metrics and confirm autoscaling headroom.

Matt: I'll be rollback owner for the service side (route unpin + traffic detach). Have the rollback runbook ready.

Sara: I'll run the smoke checklist with Alex — list below. Alex can handle log tails and error budgets.

Alex: got it. I'll run `kubectl -n prod logs -f svc/canary` and validate 200s on /health and /v1/generate sample.

Priya: Cohort selection: start global 1% -> NA-west 5% -> EU 2% -> APAC hold. If any latency p50 jump >100ms or error rate +0.5% raise flag.

Riley (oncall): I'm on standby for escalation. Ping me as @riley if we need network rollback.

qa-bot: Automated smoke tests will run at +5m and +20m after rollout start. Results posted to #ci-reports.

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: `deploy/canary-2026-03-17` scheduled at 22:00 PT. CI: green. Artifacts: build-abcdef.

Priya: small manual checklist (Sara/Alex):
- confirm canary algos pinned
- validate kv cache warmup
- sanity prompt: `{"input":"hello","max_tokens":8}` returns quickly
- billing rate limiter set to 1rps per key for canary

Matt: also confirm fallback model variant is available -> `redwood-v2-qa`.

Leo: I'll post latency/CPU dashboards link in 10m. If we see sustained qps queue growth, abort and rollback.

Priya: tagging owners: @Leo @Matt @Sara @Alex — please react :thumbsup: when ready. Will start in ~20m unless any objections.
